entities.summary: IESE Business School is the graduate business school of the University of Navarra. It was established in Barcelona in 1958 by Opus Dei. From 1963, in collaboration with Harvard Business School it offers a two-year Master of Business Administration degree. It also offers two Executive MBAs, and master´s degrees and executive education courses. It has other campuses in Madrid, Munich, New York City, and São Paulo.
